product.title: Classic Philadelphia City Bike Tour

description.text: Explore Philadelphia on a guided bike tour along the Schuylkill River Trail with stops at the Philadelphia Museum of Art, Rocky Steps, and Boathouse Row. Your guide leads a paced three-hour ride with commentary on skyline landmarks and riverfront parks. Bikes, helmets, and a safety briefing are included with routing matched to the group's ability. This active outing covers more ground than a walking tour while keeping a social, guided format.

highlights: Guided three-hour Philadelphia city bike tour
Schuylkill River Trail riding with skyline views
Philadelphia Museum of Art and Rocky Steps stop
Boathouse Row and riverfront park segments
Bikes, helmets, and safety briefing included

start.description: Meet at the bike rental staging area near the Schuylkill River Trail confirmed when booking. Arrive 15 minutes early for fitting.

end.description: Return bikes to the staging area after the final riverfront stop.
